title: DHSUD to build climate-resilient housing units in 2027

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Housing units that will be built by the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) in 2027 will be climate-resilient, according to Iloilo City Rep. Jam Baronda on Wednesday. During the deliberations of Baronda’s sponsorship of the proposed budget of the DHSUD for next year, 4K Party-list Rep. Iris Montes asked Baronda if the DHSUD has plans to construct disaster-ready homes by next year, given that the country is struck by several calamities every year.
